# BookClub text and label style inventory

Audit date: 8 October 2026 (Australia/Sydney). Investigation only; no application, stylesheet, behaviour, token, STYLE.md or ROADMAP.md changes.

## Executive summary

The audit inspected **25 screens/UI areas**, all **49 frontend TSX files**, **821 native JSX source sites**, the ten route definitions plus not-found, and the nine ordered CSS sources (**732 rule blocks; 2235 declarations**). The filterable inventory contains **1072 deduplicated text/container style contexts**, **78341 property occurrences**, and **151 recurring complete computed style signatures**. These are audit contexts, not a count of DOM nodes in one running application. Shared implementations are merged when source, attributes and effective baseline styles agree; consumers are retained.

The app already has a clear stylesheet ownership map, semantic typography/spacing tokens, a shared Action, FilmIdentity/MovieRow, ClubIdentity, SourceScores, NativeDialog and PaginationControls. Its effective conventions still rely on contextual selectors and browser inheritance. Future unification is feasible, but contextual title sizes, deliberate small attribution, semantic action variants and data-driven Metrics typography must be preserved or explicitly decided. **This report is a source-complete inventory with bounded runtime verification, not certification of every reachable state.** Reconstruction-only and isolated contexts are identified; unsupported branches must not be treated as confirmed current screen presentations.

### Navigation and routes

[frontend/routes.ts:2](../../frontend/routes.ts#L2) declares Home, History, Builder, Classics, Seen, Metrics, Admin, Event (create/edit), saved Film Detail and TMDB Preview. Not-found is the resolver fallback. Sign-in and avatar onboarding are application gates. Admin is role-gated; Builder is owner-only. Native dialogs, account dropdown, attribution, collapsed navigation tooltips, History evidence, local database indicator, notices/failures and developer disclosures are additional UI surfaces. Browser-native title tooltips, select option popups and Google GIS styling are ownership exceptions.

### Counts by property

Counts include initial/UA/inherited values, conditional source-derived contexts and finite algorithm expansions. They are **not design-token counts**. Font size includes one continuous clamp family rather than claiming that every viewport-dependent pixel size is a new convention. Layout-dependent auto widths/margins are grouped as constraints, not arbitrary measured numbers. Dormant generic CSS is separately indexed and excluded from these counts.

### How to use the two deliverables

The reverse index below has exactly one heading for each property/resolved-value pair. Every child use links to a context catalogue entry with screen, component, JSX reference/offset and classes. CSS rule sources, selectors, raw values, token resolutions and state samples accompany each use group. The CSV is long-form: one row per context × property × distinct value/provenance/state set. Filter `record_kind`, `evidence` and `origin` before interpreting counts; a token definition is not a visible element. `computed_used_value` retains viewport samples for constraints and fluid formulas. `responsive_or_interaction_state` is the measured sample set, not a declaration that the style is restricted to those widths. The CSS rule register preserves exact media/container conditions and non-winning declarations.

## Method, inheritance and evidence

1. Read AGENTS.md, STYLE.md, README.md, architecture/stylesheet ownership and testing guidance; inspect all frontend TSX and the root/app stylesheet chain. No private owner file, credential, snapshot or archive evidence was read. Existing ROADMAP.md edits were preserved.
2. Parse JSX/TSX and CSS with already-installed TypeScript/PostCSS. Enumerate conditional native text, controls, immediate containers, shared component expansions, attributes and inline styles. Source offsets distinguish multiple elements on the same compact source line. Shared invocations are not automatically new styles.
3. Resolve source-derived conditional DOM in local headless Edge/Chromium with the real stylesheets and bundled font faces. Main trees were sampled at **320, 389, 390, 480, 481, 719, 720, 950, 951, 1440 and 1920px**; isolated fallback sites at 320/1440. Open disclosure, disabled and collapsed navigation samples supplement the base. Temporary browser-only pseudo-class simulations cover hover, focus/focus-visible and disabled hover at 1440; animations/transitions were disabled only in this reconstruction harness to sample stable endpoints. These are not actual component renders and can combine mutually exclusive data branches.
4. Independently render the actual App/components with synthetic fixture data and in-memory API mocks: **163 runtime area/state/width captures** at 320, 390, 720, 951 and 1440px, with all routes, Metrics tabs, Classics tabs, Builder editor/search, native dialogs, account/drawer, footer, sign-in, avatar and developer/admin disclosures. **0 page errors; zero unmocked API/provider calls.** All API, supervisor and non-loopback requests were blocked. No maintenance operation, DB replacement, persistence write, deployment or provider call was executed. Local Vite was already running; no normal DB startup/setup command was used.
5. Expand twelve theme-cloud em sizes and fourteen report palette positions from their finite source algorithms. Continuous clamps and data-dependent chart/critic-divider geometry remain formulas.

**Cascade:** [frontend/main.tsx:4](../../frontend/main.tsx#L4) loads 300/400/500/600/700/800 font faces; [frontend/main.tsx:10](../../frontend/main.tsx#L10) loads root CSS before app.css. [frontend/app.css:2](../../frontend/app.css#L2) orders shared-content → app-shell → home-history → builder-event → classics-seen → detail → metrics → admin. Body defaults are Lexend Deca, 16px browser default, weight 400, unitless 1.5 and primary text. Controls reset `font: inherit`. App root overrides numeric font family to prose. Visible uppercase member names are produced by JavaScript (shared/identity.ts:6 and screen toUpperCase calls), not text-transform CSS; the effective CSS transform is none. Inherited colour/font values are distinct from non-inherited transparent backgrounds, borders, spacing and opacity. A parent's background/gap is recorded as a container relationship; compounded opacity is recorded separately where detectable.

**Provenance caveat:** effective values are browser computed; declaration provenance comes from selector matching, specificity/order and ancestor traversal. CSS shorthand and UA-relative small/bold rules are labelled. Selector provenance is an audit trace, not a browser source-map/cascade proof for every uncommon selector. Border colour can be defined while width is 0/style none; such colour is not a visible border. `text-decoration-line` is the local computed property; an ancestor link's underline can visually propagate even when a child reports none. Inline/stacked source-score flex variants retain their source/state references.

## Findings: inconsistencies and outliers

### Likely accidental or implementation-dependent inconsistencies

- **Undefined source-score gap token.** [frontend/styles/classics-seen.css:47](../../frontend/styles/classics-seen.css#L47) and [frontend/styles/classics-seen.css:50](../../frontend/styles/classics-seen.css#L50) use `gap: var(--space-2)`; no loaded stylesheet defines that token. Chromium computes row/column gap as `normal` (zero used gap in flex layout). `justify-content: space-between` and critic leading padding still create spacing, so this is not evidence that all source pairs visually touch. Both inline and stacked contexts are indexed.
- **Enriched Metrics retry lacks Action styling.** [frontend/EnrichedMetrics.tsx:33](../../frontend/EnrichedMetrics.tsx#L33) renders a plain `button`. It receives font inheritance but native border/background/padding, unlike ordinary shared retry Actions. This branch is source-derived, not a runtime error injection. The 13.3333px runtime text belongs to the native smaller sizing of ComparisonBars' Selected/Club `small` labels, not this retry button.
- **Metadata role overridden by broad Detail paragraph rule.** [frontend/styles/detail.css:7](../../frontend/styles/detail.css#L7) sets all header paragraphs to `--text-body-small` = 12.8px, overriding the shared `.meta` 12.48px size. Muted colour and 1.6 line height survive. This is a cascade difference, not proof of an unintended product design.
- **UA-based hierarchy/spacing.** History evidence uses unstyled `h4` ([frontend/HistoryEvidence.tsx:21](../../frontend/HistoryEvidence.tsx#L21)); browser bold/default margins remain alongside explicitly styled h1/h2/h3. ComparisonBars uses UA `small` sizing ([frontend/MetricsVisuals.tsx:10](../../frontend/MetricsVisuals.tsx#L10)). These are browser-dependent conventions rather than central roles.
- **Non-visible border declarations.** Secondary/danger Actions set border colours in [frontend/styles/shared-content.css:111](../../frontend/styles/shared-content.css#L111)–115, while the shared button border is 0. Hover border colour does not itself produce a visible edge. Treat colour-only inventory rows together with border width/style.

### Deliberate or contextually justified variations

- **Title hierarchy:** shared linked title 22.08px; History title 17.92px; mobile Classics and narrow Builder 16.56px; Seen prompt 30px; Metrics ranked-film title 20.4px; FilmIdentity title 24.8px. STYLE.md explicitly authorises History matching event heading, large Seen identity, mobile composition and contextual film roles. These are not automatically consolidation defects.
- **Large/small paired summaries:** Home stats change 28.8 → 38.4px at 720px and supporting labels 10.56 → 12.8px; The Metrics summary numeral rule declares 20.8px, but no current metrics-summary JSX consumer was found; it is retained in the CSS register rather than treated as a confirmed visible role. Film numbers use 17.92px/600 rather than the generic rank default.
- **Light narrative prose:** saved Detail, Seen plot and selected Add Classic overview use 13.6px/300/1.6. Preview retains its established header paragraph role (12.8px), with its overview beside the poster.
- **Attribution:** footer body 5.6px and disclosure 6.24px are explicitly required half-size values; the summary touch target remains 44px. Brand tagline 8.32px and dock/header text 9.92px are compact identity roles.
- **Pills/counts:** outlined badges use 2.4px 8.8px padding, 1px border, radius 999px, weight 800 and line-height 1; tab count badges use 0 4px, no border, weight 600, line-height 1.5 and semantic solid fills. They serve different roles.
- **Actions:** constructive dark green foreground `#102016`, Builder emerald add foreground black, Seen aqua/ruby answers black, danger pink, and neutral paper/secondary foregrounds are separate intentional contexts. Disabled constructive Actions preserve opacity 1 and use `#72917C`; other disabled Actions use opacity 0.3. Icon-only controls reuse 44px targets, with a context-specific 32px Classics remove control.
- **Metrics spectrum and twelve theme sizes** are ordered data presentation, explicitly described in STYLE.md. Chart fills are decorative companions to exact visible values, not extra text styles.
- **Drawer breakpoint and container queries:** 720px changes navigation; 389/480/719px refine compact controls/titles; 720–950px restores single-column content beside the drawer. Metrics/Seen container queries use actual content width, which differs between expanded/collapsed drawer and viewport width.

### Product/design decisions needed before unification

- Decide which narrowly separated metadata/helper/label values (10.4, 11.2, 12, 12.48, 12.8, 13.12, 13.6px) are genuinely distinct roles. There is no fixed 13px declaration in the inspected application CSS; 13.12px is `.82rem`, while 13.3333px is UA-relative small text.
- Decide whether Detail metadata should retain its 12.8px contextual size and whether Metrics role labels should remain normal 16px stack text rather than the 13.12px/500 `.input-label` convention.
- Decide whether 32px contextual removal geometry, small tagline/dock/attribution typography and outlined versus filled count badges should remain exceptions; do not erase documented decisions solely to reduce value counts.
- Decide whether the plain Metrics retry and unstyled h4/small elements should adopt explicit roles. Check actual error/evidence context first.
- Central tokens cover most repeated spacing, but hard-coded 26/28/42/48px framing, fractional rem values and one-off widths remain. Matching a number alone does not establish a reusable semantic component.

### Documentation drift and authority

No authoritative files were edited. Root style.css contains generic starter guidance and unused primitives (toasts, custom selects, tab/breadcrumb/switch/loading/modal systems); these must not be assumed to be BookClub's rendered patterns. Architecture correctly identifies the ordered global cascade. STYLE.md names “Lexend Deca Variable”, while main.tsx loads the package's discrete 300–800 face CSS and the declared family is “Lexend Deca”; an eventual font-loading decision should resolve that terminology. Source evidence, not historical UI audits, governs this inventory.

## Recurring complete style signatures

A signature is equality across the complete 65-property normalized computed vector (including typography, foreground/background, all border sides/corners, spacing, dimensions/constraints, wrap/overflow, outline and layout alignment), not similarity in two or three properties. At least two distinct JSX sites must share it. The vector excludes content-dependent pixel measurements for auto geometry; constraints are retained. Immediate-container relationships and dynamic finite theme colours are described in their individual context rows, not silently merged into a new component recommendation. Identical shared source used in many screens is separately traceable through its consumer list. The signatures below enumerate every recurring vector found in sampled base/mobile/desktop/disabled/hover/focus states.

## CSS rule and token register

This register preserves exact authored selectors, source lines, conditions and declarations, including declarations that lose in the cascade. “No traced winning/overridden text use” does not prove dead code: pseudo-elements, decorative artwork/chart tracks, unused root primitives and unmatched dynamic contexts need different interpretation. Root token defaults may be overridden by later application tokens or local intent variables. Token equality does not make token names interchangeable.

## Limitations and unresolved cases

- The inventory discovers all native JSX source sites and all stylesheet declarations, but **not every reachable DOM/context combination was independently rendered**. Conditional reconstruction can flatten mutually exclusive branches, ignore real data counts and create artificial ancestry/order. Isolated sites deliberately preserve source visibility without asserting an active consumer. Use source/conditions plus actual runtime evidence before implementing a change. This is the principal completeness limit.
- Geometry based on content, viewport, ch units, flex distribution, safe-area env values or percent widths is a formula/constraint. Mobile safe-area values were 0 on the desktop browser. H1 uses continuous 32–52px clamp sizing; it is impossible to enumerate every numeric viewport result. Chart widths depend on exact data and are not new typography conventions.
- Native select popups/options, browser tooltips from title, native form validity bubbles, Google GIS iframe content and OS accessibility-rendered labels were not styled or contacted. aria-label/icon-button entries describe their host control; an accessible name has no independent visible glyph styling. Inputs have no application-authored placeholder selectors/text in the inspected TSX; native empty date/number hints remain browser-owned.
- Third-party font fallback and every browser/OS rendering combination are not verified. Browser-default small/h4/control values are platform-specific; actual font-face imports are recorded. Font sizes assume the measured 16px root; browser text scaling changes rem/em results.
- Container query breakpoints were inspected in source and sampled in reconstructed content; populated runtime used the actual drawer. Not all container widths and collapsed/expanded combinations were separately captured. Major predicates are 420/540/720/1100px container widths, 389/480/719/720/950px viewport thresholds.
- Hover/focus source reconstruction is a temporary CSSOM pseudo-class simulation, not actual pointer/keyboard proof for every control. Actual collapsed drawer hover and native dialog open/Escape paths were exercised. Invalid/busy/success/maintenance progress and retry states are chiefly source-derived; no real writes/provider calls were used to manufacture them. Reduced-motion rules were source-inspected; their typography is unchanged.
- Rule trace matching is approximate for unusual specificity, logical shorthands and UA rules; resolved browser values are the stronger evidence. Ancestor text decorations, opacity and container fills need the relationship rows/rule register as well as local computed properties. Transparent is not a statement about the composite pixel behind text.
- The runtime synthetic enrichment response was empty, so populated themes/studio/country/economic comparisons are source-derived. All seven tabs were rendered; finite theme sizes/colour mappings are explicitly expanded. Dynamic inline colour/bar expressions, SourceScores' ResizeObserver-derived `--critic-divider-offset`, and data-driven stacked widths must be retained as algorithms.
- Root toasts, generic modal-panel, breadcrumb, hamburger, switch, generic data-table/tab/status-pill/loading systems have CSS but no corresponding current BookClub JSX consumers discovered. They stay in the rule register, not proof of rendered screens. Generic RankingScore hero/status/breakdown branches also lack current Home/Classics variant consumers; isolated reconstruction exposes them rather than conflating them with live compact cards.
- Source-derived sample counts include dormant/isolated candidates, so they must not be used alone as the number of conventions currently visible in product flows. The CSV supports filtering evidence and screens to distinguish those sets. No production/live data state was inspected.

### Verification and preservation

Temporary parsers, synthetic fixtures, browser captures and intermediate JSON stayed under ignored `.verification/label-audit/`. Validation checks document/CSV consistency, source references, property/value heading uniqueness, site coverage and git diff whitespace. No full application test suite was run for this documentation-only task. The two requested docs are the only task-created repository files; ROADMAP.md remains the pre-existing unrelated change.
